div.div:
What happens:
1. Lambda receives invocation
2. Handler string: run.sh
3. Runtime tries: import run.sh as Python module
4. Looks for: lambda_handler(event, context)
5. Module "run.sh" not found
Result: Runtime.HandlerNotFound ❌
Lambda expects a Python handler function,
but Flask is an HTTP server — they are incompatible.

div.div:
aws-lambda-web-adapter flow:
❶ Lambda invocation arrives (JSON event)
❷ Adapter intercepts via AWS_LAMBDA_EXEC_WRAPPER=/opt/bootstrap
❸ Starts Flask app: run.sh → gunicorn on localhost:8000
❹ Converts JSON event → HTTP request
❺ Forwards HTTP request to localhost:8000
❻ Gets HTTP response from Flask app
❼ Converts HTTP response → Lambda response format
❽ Returns response to API Gateway
Result: All endpoints work ✅
Zero application code changes required!
